links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease) of AI patient education responses
links.effect: ChatGPT FKGL 16.40 (SD 2.43) vs DeepSeek 13.48 (SD 2.35), P<0.001; FRE 26.11 vs 20.87 (P=0.110). Both models at college reading level.
links.quote: Both models produced responses at a readability level corresponding to college education.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient education materials relative to appropriate user level
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 16.40 (ChatGPT) and 13.48 (DeepSeek); Flesch Reading Ease 26.11 and 20.87, both college-level text.
links.quote: ChatGPT yielded significantly higher Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level Scores (meaning its text was more complex) (mean [SD], 16.40 [2.43] vs. 13.48 [2.35]; P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates response quality, reliability (mDISCERN), and readability of ChatGPT and DeepSeek for bariatric surgery patient education questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
